notes.title: Local Co-op support and character changes
notes.notes:
Hi guys. We have added local co-op support. You can now play with a friend on your computer, on the same keyboard or with another controller. Controls can be remapped on startup if need be.

Also fixed various bugs, as suggested by [b]stefan.klaus86[/b] which we are very thankful for! 

The unlockable characters in game now have special abilities to spice things up a bit:

Ludwig (level 10 unlock) - start with 5 apples each level
Ernesto (level 20 unlock) - double jump
Boris (level 30 unlock) - immune to enemy projectiles and damage on touch.

More stuff will be coming soon so stay tuned! Thanks guys!
